split: exact massive-hierarchy-supported-parent-v1; verify committed full preflight
encoding: pure utterance prefixed query: ; masked mean pooling; L2 normalized float32; max_length 512; batch 16; CPU one thread; eval/inference mode; seed 0
leaf_prototype: L2-normalize equal-row mean support vectors per known leaf
leaf_prediction: maximum cosine against known leaf prototypes; exact ties lexicographic opaque leaf ID
rejection: reject iff maximum leaf cosine < frozen threshold; identical leaf predictions and mask across parent arms
calibration: validation known/hidden binary labels only. Candidates -1, sorted distinct validation scores, nextafter(max,+infinity). Maximize balanced known-accept / hidden-reject accuracy using exact integer numerator; ties maximize known acceptance, then choose smallest threshold. No parent labels or test scores used.
parent_arms: flat: map highest-similarity known leaf to supplied parent
equal-leaf-mean: normalize equal-weight mean of normalized known child-leaf prototypes; max cosine over supported parents, ties lexicographic opaque parent ID
prediction_boundary: score all test predictions and shared rejection mask once with frozen validation threshold before any test gold scoring; no query-dependent reranking, online updating or test tuning
metrics: validation and test separate; hidden all-row parent accuracy and joint reject+correct-parent, conditional parent accuracy among rejected with numerator/denominator; parent-macro averages over gold parents with hidden queries; known leaf accuracy, acceptance coverage and false novelty, conditional accepted correctness; all plus gold-parent one/multiple supported-child strata
scope: supported parents only; hidden validation/test leaves disjoint; topology supervised; not open-parent discovery, oracle K clustering, temporal novelty or natural frequency distribution
resource_scope: separate encoder time/process highwater; source-free vector-worker fit/predict/calibrate/score time and process RSS baseline/highwater; not exact owned-heap or continuous peak
